data.long_description:
Stunning 3-bedroom apartment in Binghatti Gardenia, Jumeirah Village Circle, featuring a rare private pool and beautiful open views. Located on a high floor, the unit offers a spacious open-plan living and dining area, modern fitted kitchen, floor-to-ceiling windows, and three generously sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes.


  Bright, well-designed layout with contemporary finishes throughout, ensuring comfort, privacy, and a strong sense of space.




  The building offers premium amenities including a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, landscaped areas, children’s play zones, covered parking, and 24/7 security. The building is centrally located within JVC, providing easy access to Circle Mall, supermarkets, schools, parks, and major road networks.

   Spacious layout | 1,727 sqft | 2 parking spaces
